text:
sam: quick heads-up — i'm planning a tiny data-model change to analytics.events for console telemetry. want to add two nullable fields: routing_policy (string) and quota_bucket (string). main motivation: clearer routing/quotas tracing for rollout UX and per-route cost dashboards. any objections?

julia: curious about cardinality — routing_policy values could explode if teams define freeform names. can we enumerate or map to ids? also affects indexes.

sam: good call. proposal: keep routing_policy as low-cardinality labels (edge, regional, fallback, experimental) enforced at ingestion. for custom policies we map them to these buckets + store policy_id separately in metadata store (not in events table).

kevin: 👍 on mapping. how about migration strategy? we should avoid a heavy backfill and avoid blocking deploys for queries that expect the old schema.

sam: plan sketch: 1) add nullable cols with defaults NULL 2) update ingestion pipeline to populate new cols for new events only (write path) 3) update console/analytics queries to use COALESCE(routing_policy, legacy_policy) so old events still show up 4) run async backfill for last 90 days and keep old fields for 30d after backfill complete.

ada: can you paste the ALTER commands? will need eng-infra sign-off for schema churn on the hot table.

sam: sure — minimal example:

```sql
ALTER TABLE analytics.events
ADD COLUMN routing_policy TEXT NULL,
ADD COLUMN quota_bucket TEXT NULL;

-- add index for query patterns we expect:
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_routing_service ON analytics.events (service, routing_policy) WHERE routing_policy IS NOT NULL;
```

julia: `CONCURRENTLY` is good. also consider partition pruning: this table is daily-partitioned by event_date, right? backfill can be done per-partition in parallel.

kevin: perf note — adding index with WHERE routing_policy IS NOT NULL keeps index small. but watch out for write amplification on hot partitions. infra should gate this during low-traffic window.

noop-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by kevin at 2026-05-15T03:00:00Z for infra-change window.

sam: another compatibility idea: create a view analytics.events_v2 that canonicalizes fields so console queries migrate once:

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW analytics.events_v2 AS
SELECT *, COALESCE(routing_policy, metadata->> 'legacy_policy') AS routing_policy_canonical,
       COALESCE(quota_bucket, (metadata->> 'quota') ) AS quota_bucket_canonical
FROM analytics.events;
```

ada: if we do a view we must update the RBAC review since queries for billing use events directly. also update docs for the metrics team.

julia: what about schema evolution in the SDKs? server SDK emits event payloads. do we version the output or simply add fields? backward compatible if we add optional fields.

sam: add fields only and bump ingestion lambda to write them when present. no breaking changes.

kevin: propose rollout steps:
- infra: scheduled alter + index create in low-traffic window
- ingestion: feature-flagged change to start populating new cols (no backfill)
- console: switch main dashboards to use events_v2 view (behind flag)
- backfill: per-partition job for 90d (monitor scan rate and errors)
- cleanup: drop legacy mapping column after 120d and remove feature flags

ada: i'll start the infra ticket and include the index creation plan + rollback steps. also need SLAs during the alter.

julia: small thought — quota_bucket might map to numeric tiers later. store a readable string now, but leave a quota_bucket_id nullable int for future join. don't add it now to keep schema minimal.

sam: agreed. we'll keep it text for now and add an audit column to capture ingestion source.

kevin: ok. next action items: sam to draft PR with ALTER and view DDL, ada to add ingestion lambda change and feature flag, nada to open infra change request. i'll own the backfill job plan.

sam: thanks. i'll post the PR link here when ready and tag infra for the alter window. :thumbsup:

ada: noted — i'll coordinate the change window with eng-sre.

kevin: one more: add a small eval query for rollout UX to ensure no sudden dips in dashboard metrics:

```sql
SELECT routing_policy_canonical, count(1) FROM analytics.events_v2
WHERE event_date >= current_date - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```

sam: perfect.

ada: last note: add monitoring on table bloat and replica lag during index build. set alerts.

sam: will do. thanks all!
